column9: note
betaln and beta inaccurate for max(a,b) >= 8 (algdiv transcription error)
jnp.histogram puts values on an interior bin edge into the wrong bin
pareto checks support on x but computes on (x-loc)/scale
expon.logcdf returns -inf for small positive x
laplace.cdf has NaN gradients in the tails
jit with negative static_argnums does not treat a keyword argument as static
zeta: differentiating changes the primal value
poisson.entropy has NaN gradients outside a middle range of mu
betaln(inf, b) returns nan
i0 and i1 overflow to inf before the result does
uniform cdf/pdf/logpdf map NaN input to finite values
vonmises returns NaN at kappa = 0
rel_entr maps NaN input to +inf
kl_div returns NaN for infinite arguments
cauchy ppf/isf finite at and outside [0, 1]
chi2.logpdf(0, 2) returns NaN
dirichlet gives zero density on the simplex boundary
multinomial.logpmf returns -inf for batched input
erfcx returns 0 in a band below the asymptotic switch
xlogy(0, nan) and xlog1py(0, nan) return 0
abs(inf + nan j) returns nan instead of inf
digamma(0.0) returns nan instead of -inf
loggamma(0.0) returns nan instead of inf
zeta(x, q) is silently wrong for q below about -6
Array.sum(initial=...) drops the initial value
fwd_and_bwd drops keyword arguments
pmean (and psum of a constant) with unequal axis_index_groups divides every group by the size of the first group
gammaln(-inf) returns +inf where SciPy returns -inf
rel_entr/kl_div wrong for p close to q and nan for large p
gammaincc returns values outside [0, 1] for large a
random.poisson samples have the wrong variance for large lam
t.logpdf loses precision for large df
linalg.eigh accepts a non-square matrix and decomposes a different one
expn(n, 0) returns 1/n instead of 1/(n-1)
floor_divide off by one for some float16/bfloat16 inputs
jax.scipy.special.expi(0.0) returns nan instead of -inf
poisson.logpmf tests k for integrality instead of k - loc, so a fractional loc gives every support point probability zero
jnp.add.reduceat and jnp.multiply.reduceat ignore the dtype argument
